page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of 1 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The CPU flags indicate a lack of advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, or hardware-accelerated cryptography extensions.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for entry-level workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or high-performance vector processing. It is positioned for general-purpose tasks, such as lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, development environments, and small database instances.
